id.description: The agent's ID: org/name, or org/@user/name for one that works for a user.

status.description: Whether it waits for a message, answers one, waits on a person, or sleeps until something asks it.

pending.description: How many messages wait behind what it's doing.

node.description: The node it runs on, by its name; null while it sleeps.

next_run.description: When the next of its triggers on a clock runs; null where none does.
